# LarkUI (@larkui/core)

> Feishu Universe Design (UD) React 19 component library covering all 44 official components. Headless behaviour comes from @ui-sdk/react; visual specs come from the official Feishu design docs and the extracted 7.72 client CSS. Styles are Tailwind CSS v4 + cva + CSS custom properties.

## When to use

- Building a Feishu/Lark product UI in React 19.
- Needing accessible, keyboard-complete controls without hand-rolling ARIA.
- Wanting UD-faithful dimensions, colours and states.

## Setup

```tsx
import { Button, Input, Select, Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTrigger } from "@larkui/core";
import "@larkui/core/styles.css";
```

- React 19 peer dependency.
- Import global styles once at the app root.
- Dark mode: add `.dark` or `data-theme="dark"` to `html`.
- Override tokens with the `--lark-*` custom properties from `packages/tokens/src/tokens.css`.

## Conventions

- Every component has one folder: `src/components/<Name>/{index.ts,<Name>.tsx,<Name>.test.tsx,<Name>.stories.tsx}`.
- Every part exposes `data-slot`; state uses attributes such as `data-checked`, `data-open`, `data-disabled`, `data-pending`.
- Behaviours are imported from `@ui-sdk/react/<component>`; never add a bare `role="dialog"`, `role="listbox"` or keyboard handler.
- Variants use `cva`; final classes use `cn()` (tailwind-merge configured with the Lark colour scale).
- Use `--lark-*` tokens or the `text-lark-*`, `bg-lark-*`, `border-lark-*` utilities. Do not hardcode hex colours.

## Component inventory

Data entry: Button, Input, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Select, Form, Slider, Stepper, Rate, Cascader, ColorPicker, DatePicker, TimePicker, Transfer, TreeSelect, Upload.
Data display: Tag, Badge, Avatar, Card, Collapse, Tabs, Tooltip, Timeline, Empty, Popover, Table, ImageViewer, Placeholder.
Feedback: Dialog, Drawer, Notice, Notification, Loading, Progress, Toast.
Navigation: Anchor, Breadcrumb, Dropdown, NavigationMenu, Pagination, ScrollBar, Steps.

See `COMPONENTS.md` for statuses and `README.md` for usage. Storybook story ids use `components-<name>--<story>` under `Components/<Name>`.

## Commands

```bash
pnpm --filter @larkui/core typecheck
pnpm --filter @larkui/core test
pnpm --filter @larkui/core build
pnpm storybook
```

## Ground truth

- Official docs: `larkit doc read /tools-and-resources/design-specification/<category>/<component>`
- Client CSS: `/root/code/lark-kumo/.feishu-extracted/asar/messenger/**/*.css`
- Tokens: `packages/tokens/src/tokens.css`
- Authoring contract: `AGENTS.md`
